name: dsh-penguin-playground
description: DSH web plugin: penguin playground — a 2D penguin desktop pet animated by a spring-joint engine, plus penguin theme tokens, an input-row easter-egg button, a status dock and a settings section. v1.2 adds projectile-defecation ballistics (tokens burned become poop, aimed into one growing pile that explodes at 40); v1.2.1 reworks that action, fixes mirrored poses when facing left, and retunes the eye patch; v1.2.2 cancels a pending jump when the action starts; v1.3 adds swimming — the pet submerges below a wavy waterline inside a small animated pool; v1.4 rebuilds the model (80 KB side-view skeleton, per-part MODULE_TUNING table, new sideMix / footLock / wingLift / swimTune / poopTune joints); v1.5 adds switchable species — Adélie and Emperor — with reworked flippers, a continuous back coat, larger eyes and solid triangular call rays; v1.6 adds the Chinstrap penguin (black round head, white cheeks and throat, narrow black chin band, short near-black beak) plus per-species body scale, tail offset and stage size, and tail-root bridge feathers so the rotating tail stays joined to the rump.
